title: Fix YouTube satellite remount resume via player API
description: YouTube embeds still restart at 0 when entering/exiting satellite mode or becoming main content. Prior start= URL resume/deferred src did not affect real behavior; use YouTube IFrame Player API seek after mount.
close_reason: Fixed by using YouTube IFrame Player API seek/getCurrentTime for satellite remount resume.

title: Fix YouTube resume timing on focus transition
description: Previous approximate YouTube iframe time tracking did not change observed behavior. Investigate why focus/satellite transition still remounts at 0, then fix root cause. Likely cleanup-time update arrives after new iframe is mounted and ignored.
acceptance_criteria: Regression test reproduces focus transition receiving playback time after mount; YouTube iframe updates/remounts once with remembered start time; no repeated iframe reload on every tick; checks pass.
close_reason: Fixed the missed transition case: if YouTube playback time arrives after the new iframe mounts, the iframe now receives one deferred resume src with start=<seconds>, then ignores later per-second ticks to avoid reload loops. Verified focused regression, full unit suite, lint/typecheck/format, build, and desktop/mobile e2e.

title: Preserve YouTube time across satellite remounts
description: Investigate and fix YouTube iframe restart when entering or switching focus/satellite mode. Current autoplay-muted remount starts at 0; preserve approximate or API-backed playback position across remounts without persisting third-party media URLs or payloads.
acceptance_criteria: YouTube URL source remounts use remembered playback time instead of restarting at 0; time state remains runtime-only; focused tests and verification pass.
close_reason: YouTube iframe panes now record runtime-only approximate playback seconds in videoPositions and remount with start=<seconds> instead of restarting at 0. Iframe src is mount-stable so position ticks do not reload the player. Verified focused tests, full unit suite, lint/typecheck/format, build, and desktop/mobile e2e.

title: Keep YouTube playing through satellite mode
description: Investigate and fix YouTube-specific playback stopping when a YouTube iframe enters focus/satellite mode or moves into the satellite side rail. Native video was fixed, but YouTube iframe remount/autoplay behavior still stops playback.
acceptance_criteria: YouTube embeds created by the resolver are satellite-friendly; entering/focusing satellite mode keeps YouTube playing as much as iframe constraints allow; focused regression tests and verification pass.
close_reason: YouTube provider and yt-dlp embed URLs now include autoplay, mute, and playsinline parameters, and URL iframes grant autoplay permission. This makes YouTube remounts in satellite/focus mode resume playback as much as iframe constraints allow. Verified focused tests, full unit suite, lint/typecheck/format, build, and desktop/mobile e2e.

title: Fix satellite video playback and selection

close_reason: Satellite panes now keep playback active, hide nested media controls, and use a focus overlay so clicks select/focus the source instead of toggling video playback. Verified with focused Vitest, full Vitest, lint, typecheck, format check, build, and Playwright desktop/mobile.
